message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The failing assertion was in `test/vat.test.js`. It expected `withVat(250)` to be 301, but 250 × 1.2 = 300 exactly, so nothing needs rounding. I changed the expectation to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone, since its logic matches its comment ("price in pence including 20% VAT, rounded to the nearest penny").

The change is not committed. Say if you want it committed.
